description: Runs the blocks below it repeatedly within one pass, like a C loop: for (i = start; i compared with end; i = i changed by step), bounded by a turn budget.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled. The whole loop runs inside the pass: a long loop makes the pass long and delays everything else in the program.

eno.description: Put a block on its enable to make it, and what depends on it, part of the loop.

outputs.description: The loop variable, published before each turn.

fields.description: The iterator's first value. A wired start wins over the one in the body. It must be a finite number.
The value the iterator is compared with. A wired end wins over the one in the body. It must be a finite number.
What the iterator advances by on each turn. A wired step wins over the one in the body. A step that never reaches the end stops at the turn budget.
How the iterator advances on each turn.
The loop runs while the iterator compares this way with the end.

options.description: The iterator is less than the end.
The iterator is less than or equal to the end.
The iterator is greater than the end.
The iterator is greater than or equal to the end.

fields.description: A hard budget of turns per pass that stops a loop that would not end (a step of 0, a wrong direction). Hitting it is reported and the loop stops.
